description: This Java class defines a TileService for Android's quick settings, adding a tile that opens a new note editing activity when tapped.

classes.name: NewNoteTileService
classes.description: A TileService that adds a quick settings tile to create a new note in the Nextcloud Notes Android client.

methods.name: onStartListening
methods.description: Sets the quick settings tile to active state when the tile starts listening.

methods.name: onClick
methods.description: Handles the tile click event to launch the new note activity, ensuring it doesn't open multiple times and unlocking the screen if necessary.
